mapper.select: SELECT * FROM gym_banner WHERE gym_id = #{gymId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gym_banner (gym_id, image_url, title, is_active, sort_order) VALUES (#{gymId}, #{banner.imageUrl}, #{banner.title}, 1, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(sort_order) + 1 FROM gym_banner b2 WHERE b2.gym_id = #{gymId}), 0))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM gym_banner WHERE id = #{id} AND gym_id = #{gymId}
mapper.update: UPDATE gym_banner SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id} AND gym_id = #{gymId}
UPDATE gym_banner SET is_active = #{isActive} WHERE id = #{id} AND gym_id = #{gymId}
